stem: Based on the information, which star is most like the sun?
visual_elements: The spectral classes of four stars are shown in comparison with a Hertzsprung-Russell diagram.
A Hertzsprung-Russell diagram with Luminosity (L_sun) on the vertical axis from 10^-4 to 10^6 and Temperature (K) on the horizontal axis from 25,000 to 3,000.
Spectral classes along horizontal axis: O, B, A, F, G, K, M.
Clusters labeled: Supergiants (top right), Giants (middle right), Main-sequence stars (middle diagonal band), White dwarfs (bottom left).
Below the diagram is a line with 4 star icons located at spectral classes: Star 1 at O, Star 2 at A, Star 3 at G, Star 4 at M.
